name: Coco Regulatory Compliance
trigger: Coco's automated monitoring agent detects one of the listed conditions and it does not self-resolve within 2 minutes.
purpose: Coco is an AI agent that monitors Coco cities for bot issues that could cause regulatory problems (overcrowded clusters, unsafe spacing, bots obstructing public pathways) and dispatches a worker when something looks wrong. These are the conditions it watches for and how a dispatched worker should respond. Scope: Coco, all markets.
doneWhen: The flagged condition is resolved and the worker has photographed the resolved state.

steps.title: Coco's agent detects a watched condition
steps.trigger: A bot or cluster matches one of the twelve watched conditions.
steps.work: Watched conditions: more than 5 bots in a cluster; clusters under 50 feet apart; more than 2 bots driving together during deploy/undeploy; a bot encroaching on the sidewalk right of way, fallen onto the road, blocking an ADA ramp or doorway, tipped over, stuck in a road, crosswalk, train track or alley; a bot missing its flag, flag bent down, or graffitied.

steps.title: Did it resolve itself within 2 minutes?
steps.work: The agent waits two minutes. If the condition clears on its own, no worker is dispatched.

steps.title: Dispatch a worker
steps.work: The agent dispatches a worker to the bot's location with the condition and the expected resolution.

steps.title: Arrive and photograph the bot
steps.work: Go to the bot and take a photo of it on arrival, before touching anything.

steps.title: Does the issue match a listed condition?
steps.trigger: The worker has assessed the bot.
steps.work: Compare what you see with the watched-conditions table. Anything not on the list is escalated rather than improvised.

steps.title: Resolve per the condition table
steps.trigger: The issue matches a listed condition.
steps.work: Clusters: reduce to 5 or fewer bots, or increase spacing to 50+ feet; stop additional deployments if more than 2 bots are driving together. Right-of-way issues: move the bot out of the right of way, back onto the sidewalk, or stand it up and move it. Flag missing: ground the bot, add the flag if you have the part. Flag bent: put it back up. Graffiti: ground the bot and clean it if you have supplies.

next.label: Needs a part or supplies you don't have

steps.title: Return the bot to depot
steps.trigger: A grounded bot needs a part or supplies the worker does not have.
steps.work: Return the bot to depot rather than leaving it in place.

steps.title: Photograph the resolved state and complete the task
steps.trigger: The condition is resolved (or the bot is at depot).
steps.work: Take a second photo showing the resolved state, then complete the task in the dispatch tooling.

steps.title: Escalate an unlisted issue
steps.trigger: The issue does not match any watched condition.
steps.work: Escalate to the SOP owner's designated contact with the arrival photo and a description. The contact is not yet filled in on the source page.
